sql: SELECT p.id FROM people p WHERE p.workspace_id = $1 AND p.merged_into IS NULL AND (((CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof((p.traits -> $3::text)) = 'string' THEN CASE WHEN pg_input_is_valid((p.traits ->> $3::text), 'date') THEN (((p.traits ->> $3::text))::date::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') END END IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM events e WHERE e.workspace_id = p.workspace_id AND e.person_id = p.id AND e.name = $2::text AND e.occurred_at >= CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof((p.traits -> $3::text)) = 'string' THEN CASE WHEN pg_input_is_valid((p.traits ->> $3::text), 'date') THEN (((p.traits ->> $3::text))::date::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') END END)) AND (CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof((p.traits -> $4::text)) = 'string' THEN CASE WHEN pg_input_is_valid((p.traits ->> $4::text), 'timestamptz') THEN ((p.traits ->> $4::text))::timestamptz END END IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM events e WHERE e.workspace_id = p.workspace_id AND e.person_id = p.id AND e.name = $2::text AND e.occurred_at >= CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof((p.traits -> $4::text)) = 'string' THEN CASE WHEN pg_input_is_valid((p.traits ->> $4::text), 'timestamptz') THEN ((p.traits ->> $4::text))::timestamptz END END))))
